title: Where, When, and How Many Bits? Scaling Laws for SGD with Stochastic Rounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.41074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-precision training reduces computation but introduces additional rounding error. We theoretically study how stochastic rounding (SR) affects prediction risk as model size, training time, and precision change. We consider a two-layer linear network with a fixed random first layer, trained by mini-batch SGD on fresh Gaussian data with power-law spectra. At each SGD step, the features used in forward and backward computations are rounded independently. We prove matched upper and lower bounds on prediction error for the final model and for uniform parameter averaging, with general learning-rate and precision schedules chosen before training. For fixed precisions and constant learning rates with parameter averaging, we derive how the smallest prediction error decreases with compute, and we identify model sizes and training times that achieve this optimal-compute scaling. translated_title: 何处、何时、以及多少比特？随机舍入下SGD的缩放定律
translated_abstract: 低精度训练可以减少计算量，但会引入额外的舍入误差。我们从理论上研究了随着模型规模、训练时间和精度的变化，随机舍入（SR）如何影响预测风险。我们考虑一个第一层固定且随机的两层线性网络，在具有幂律谱的全新高斯数据上通过小批量SGD进行训练。在每一步SGD中，前向和反向计算所使用的特征被独立舍入。对于训练前预先选定的通用学习率与精度调度，我们针对最终模型以及均匀参数平均证明了预测误差的匹配上下界。对于固定精度和恒定学习率并结合参数平均的情形，我们推导出最小预测误差如何随计算量下降，并识别出达到这种最优计算缩放所需的模型规模和训练时间。仅对前向特征进行舍入可保持……的计算缩放规律（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文通过两层线性网络的理论分析，证明了随机舍入下低精度SGD训练预测误差的匹配上下界，并给出了达到最优计算缩放时所需的模型规模、训练时间与精度调度选择规律。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically analyzes low-precision SGD training with stochastic rounding via a two-layer linear network, proving matched upper and lower bounds on prediction error and identifying the model size, training time, and precision schedules required to achieve optimal compute scaling.
